action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in zip([logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call],
                         ["logp_with_result", "logp_call_only", "logp_no_call"]):
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")
    # Check shape match
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    # Compute loss sums (negative log probability summed over future horizon)
    loss_result = -logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    loss_call = -logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)
    
    # Compute margin: improvement over the better baseline (lower loss is better)
    margin = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call) - loss_result
    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold
    keep_mask = margin > tau_filter
    # Ensure boolean output
    keep_mask = np.asarray(keep_mask, dtype=bool)
    margin = np.asarray(margin, dtype=float)
    return (keep_mask, margin)
